verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents a first-party MCP server letting agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.) query logs, traces, and run evals, plus a full REST API for programmatic access to projects, experiments, logs, and metrics, and a Loop AI agent that investigates logs/eval data via natural language. Confirmed by probe evidence of the live MCP docs page. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification of the MCP server working end-to-end with an external agent (only vendor docs and a probe confirming the page exists).
